D2251M1   F7.HOME MORTGAGE
          Section: F            Level: Household          CAI Reference: Q2251
          Type: Numeric         Width: 1                  Decimals: 0

          F7. Do you have a mortgage, land contract, second mortgage, or any other
          loan that uses the property as collateral? Please do not include home equity
